name: Wild
summary:
**Explore with friends.**

Wild is one big social space. Walk across the map, follow the noise, visit other players, or let your curiosity lead the way.

**Life as a duck.**

Customize your duck avatar, and express yourself in ways only possible inside VR. Walk, run, or jump around with hand-based movement.

**Welcome to the community.**

When you join Wild, you’re joining a new world that is constantly changing. Tune into events, changes to the map, or try out the latest cosmetics.
